1.english_reference: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּ֣ה בֶן אָדָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: Καὶ σύ , υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου ,
traditions.VUL: Et tu fili hóminis ,
traditions.KJV: Now , thou son of man ,

2.english_reference: wilt thou judge , wilt thou judge the bloody city ?

traditions.WLC: הֲ תִשְׁפֹּ֥ט הֲ תִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת עִ֣יר הַ דָּמִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: εἰ κρινεῖς τὴν πόλιν τῶν αἱμάτων ?
traditions.VUL: nonne iúdicas , nonne iúdicas civitátem sánguinum ?
traditions.KJV: wilt thou judge , wilt thou judge the bloody city ?

2.english_reference: yea , thou shalt shew her all her abominations .

traditions.WLC: וְ ה֣וֹדַעְתָּ֔ הּ אֵ֖ת כָּל תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶֽי הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ παράδειξον αὐτῇ πάσας τὰς ἀνομίας αὐτῆς ,
traditions.KJV: yea , thou shalt shew her all her abominations .

traditions.VUL: Et osténdes ei omnes abominatiónes suas ,

3.english_reference: Then say thou , Thus saith the Lord GOD ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַרְתָּ֗ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣ י יְהוִ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐρεῖς Τάδε λέγει κύριος Κύριος
traditions.VUL: et dices : Hæc dicit Dóminus Deus :
traditions.KJV: Then say thou , Thus saith the Lord GOD ,

3.english_reference: The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it , that her time may come ,

traditions.WLC: עִ֣יר שֹׁפֶ֥כֶת דָּ֛ם בְּ תוֹכָ֖ הּ לָ ב֣וֹא עִתָּ֑ הּ
traditions.LXX: Ὦ πόλις ἐκχέουσα αἵματα ἐν μέσῳ αὐτῆς τοῦ εἰσελθεῖν καιρὸν αὐτῆς ,
traditions.VUL: Cívitas effúndens sánguinem in médio sui , ut véniat tempus eius :
traditions.KJV: The city sheddeth blood in the midst of it , that her time may come ,

3.english_reference: and maketh idols against herself to defile herself .

traditions.WLC: וְ עָשְׂתָ֧ה גִלּוּלִ֛ים עָלֶ֖י הָ לְ טָמְאָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ποιοῦσα ἐνθυμήματα καθ᾽ αὑτῆς τοῦ μιαίνειν αὐτήν .
traditions.VUL: et quæ fecit idóla contra semetípsam , ut polluerétur .
traditions.KJV: and maketh idols against herself to defile herself .

4.english_reference: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed ;

traditions.LXX: ἐν τοῖς αἵμασιν αὐτῶν οἷς ἐξέχεας παραπέπτωκας ,
traditions.VUL: In sánguine tuo , qui a te effúsus est , deliquísti :
traditions.KJV: Thou art become guilty in thy blood that thou hast shed ;

4.english_reference: and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made ;

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ גִלּוּלַ֤יִ ךְ אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂית֙ טָמֵ֔את
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἐνθυμήμασίν σου οἷς ἐποίεις ἐμιαίνου ,
traditions.VUL: et in idólis tuis , quæ fecísti , pollúta es :
traditions.KJV: and hast defiled thyself in thine idols which thou hast made ;

4.english_reference: and thou hast caused thy days to draw near , and art come [ even ] unto thy years :

traditions.WLC: וַ תַּקְרִ֣יבִי יָמַ֔יִ ךְ וַ תָּב֖וֹא עַד שְׁנוֹתָ֑יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἤγγισας τὰς ἡμέρας σου , καὶ ἤγαγες καιρὸν ἐτῶν σου .
traditions.VUL: et appropinquáre fecísti dies tuos , et adduxísti tempus annórum tuórum :
traditions.KJV: and thou hast caused thy days to draw near , and art come [ even ] unto thy years :

4.english_reference: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen , and a mocking to all countries .

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֗ן נְתַתִּ֤י ךְ חֶרְפָּה֙ לַ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְ קַלָּסָ֖ה לְ כָל הָ אֲרָצֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο δέδωκά σε εἰς ὄνειδος τοῖς ἔθνεσιν καὶ εἰς ἐμπαιγμὸν πάσαις ταῖς χώραις
traditions.VUL: proptérea dedi te oppróbrium géntibus , et irrisiónem univérsis terris .
traditions.KJV: therefore have I made thee a reproach unto the heathen , and a mocking to all countries .

5.english_reference: [ Those that be ] near , and [ those that be ] far from thee , shall mock thee ,

traditions.WLC: הַ קְּרֹב֛וֹת וְ הָ רְחֹק֥וֹת מִמֵּ֖ ךְ יִתְקַלְּסוּ בָ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ταῖς ἐγγιζούσαις πρὸς σὲ καὶ ταῖς μακρὰν ἀπεχούσαις ἀπὸ σοῦ , καὶ ἐμπαίξονται ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: Quæ iuxta sunt , et quæ procul a te , triumphábunt de te :
traditions.KJV: [ Those that be ] near , and [ those that be ] far from thee , shall mock thee , [ which art ]

5.english_reference: [ which art ] infamous [ and ] much vexed .

traditions.WLC: טְמֵאַ֣ת הַ שֵּׁ֔ם רַבַּ֖ת הַ מְּהוּמָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἀκάθαρτος ἡ ὀνομαστὴ καὶ πολλὴ ἐν ταῖς ἀνομίαις .
traditions.VUL: sórdida , nóbilis , grandis intéritu .
traditions.KJV: infamous [ and ] much vexed .

6.english_reference: Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּה֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֥ישׁ לִ זְרֹע֖ וֹ הָ֣יוּ בָ֑ ךְ לְמַ֖עַן שְׁפָךְ דָּֽם
traditions.LXX: ἰδοὺ οἱ ἀφηγούμενοι οἴκου Ἰσραήλ , ἕκαστος πρὸς τοὺς συγγενεῖς αὐτοῦ , συνεφύροντο ἐν σοὶ ὅπως ἐκχέωσιν αἷμα ·
traditions.VUL: Ecce príncipes Israel sínguli in bráchio suo fuérunt in te , ad effundéndum sánguinem .
traditions.KJV: Behold , the princes of Israel , every one were in thee to their power to shed blood .

7.english_reference: In thee have they set light by father and mother :

traditions.WLC: אָ֤ב וָ אֵם֙ הֵקַ֣לּוּ בָ֔ ךְ
traditions.LXX: πατέρα καὶ μητέρα ἐκακολόγουν ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: Patrem , et matrem contuméliis affecérunt ,
traditions.KJV: In thee have they set light by father and mother :

7.english_reference: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger :

traditions.WLC: לַ גֵּ֛ר עָשׂ֥וּ בַ עֹ֖שֶׁק בְּ תוֹכֵ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ προσήλυτον ἀνεστρέφοντο ἐν ἀδικίαις ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: in te ádvenam calumniáti sunt in médio tui ,
traditions.KJV: in the midst of thee have they dealt by oppression with the stranger :

7.english_reference: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .

traditions.WLC: יָת֥וֹם וְ אַלְמָנָ֖ה ה֥וֹנוּ בָֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ὀρφανὸν καὶ χήραν κατεδυνάστευον ,
traditions.VUL: pupíllum et víduam contristavérunt apud te .
traditions.KJV: in thee have they vexed the fatherless and the widow .

8.english_reference: Thou hast despised mine holy things ,

traditions.WLC: קָדָשַׁ֖ י בָּזִ֑ית
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ ἅγιά μου ἐξουδένουν
traditions.VUL: Sanctuária mea sprevísti ,
traditions.KJV: Thou hast despised mine holy things ,

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖ י חִלָּֽלְתְּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὰ σάββατά μου ἐβεβήλουν ἐν σοί .
traditions.VUL: et sábbata mea polluísti .
traditions.KJV: and hast profaned my sabbaths .

9.english_reference: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood :

traditions.WLC: אַנְשֵׁ֥י רָכִ֛יל הָ֥יוּ בָ֖ ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ דָּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: ἄνδρες λῃσταὶ ἐν σοί , ὅπως ἐκχέωσιν ἐν σοὶ αἷμα ,
traditions.VUL: Viri detractóres fuérunt in te ad effundéndum sánguinem ,
traditions.KJV: In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood :

9.english_reference: and in thee they eat upon the mountains :

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶל הֶֽ הָרִים֙ אָ֣כְלוּ בָ֔ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν ὀρέων ἤσθοσαν ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: et super montes comedérunt in te ,
traditions.KJV: and in thee they eat upon the mountains :

9.english_reference: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness .

traditions.WLC: זִמָּ֖ה עָשׂ֥וּ בְ תוֹכֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἀνόσια ἐποίουν ἐν μέσῳ σου .
traditions.VUL: scelus operáti sunt in médio tui .
traditions.KJV: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness .

10.english_reference: In thee have they discovered their fathers ’ nakedness :

traditions.WLC: עֶרְוַת אָ֖ב גִּלָּה בָ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: αἰσχύνην πατρὸς ἀπεκάλυψαν ἐν σοί ,
traditions.VUL: Verecundióra patris discooperuérunt in te :
traditions.KJV: In thee have they discovered their fathers ’ nakedness :

10.english_reference: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution .

traditions.WLC: טְמֵאַ֥ת הַ נִּדָּ֖ה עִנּוּ בָֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐν ἀκαθαρσίαις ἀποκαθημένην ἐταπείνουν ἐν σοί ·
traditions.VUL: immundítiam menstruátæ humiliavérunt in te :
traditions.KJV: in thee have they humbled her that was set apart for pollution .

11.english_reference: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour ’s wife

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֗ הוּ עָשָׂה֙ תּֽוֹעֵבָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἕκαστος τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ ἠνομοῦσαν ,
traditions.VUL: et unusquísque in uxórem próximi sui operátus est abominatiónem ,
traditions.KJV: And one hath committed abomination with his neighbour ’s wife ;

11.english_reference: and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת כַּלָּת֖ וֹ טִמֵּ֣א בְ זִמָּ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἕκαστος τὴν νύμφην αὐτοῦ ἐμίαινεν ἐν ἀσεβείᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: et socer nurum suam pólluit nefárie ,
traditions.KJV: and another hath lewdly defiled his daughter in law ;

11.english_reference: and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father ’s daughter

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֛ישׁ אֶת אֲחֹת֥ וֹ בַת אָבִ֖י ו עִנָּה בָֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἕκαστος τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτοῦ θυγατέρα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐταπείνουν ἐν σοί .
traditions.VUL: frater sorórem suam fíliam patris sui oppréssit in te .
traditions.KJV: and another in thee hath humbled his sister , his father ’s daughter .

12.english_reference: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood

traditions.WLC: שֹׁ֥חַד לָֽקְחוּ בָ֖ ךְ לְמַ֣עַן שְׁפָךְ דָּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: δῶρα ἐλαμβάνοσαν ἐν σοί , ὅπως ἐκχέωσιν αἷμα ,
traditions.VUL: Múnera accepérunt apud te ad effundéndum sánguinem :
traditions.KJV: In thee have they taken gifts to shed blood ;

12.english_reference: thou hast taken usury and increase

traditions.WLC: נֶ֧שֶׁךְ וְ תַרְבִּ֣ית לָקַ֗חַתְּ
traditions.LXX: τόκον καὶ πλεονασμὸν ἐλαμβάνοσαν ἐν σοί ·
traditions.VUL: usúram , et superabundántiam accepísti ,
traditions.KJV: thou hast taken usury and increase ,

12.english_reference: and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּבַצְּעִ֤י רֵעַ֨יִ ךְ֙ בַּ עֹ֔שֶׁק
traditions.LXX: καὶ συνετελέσω συντέλειαν κακίας σου τὴν ἐν καταδυναστείᾳ ,
traditions.VUL: et aváre próximos tuos calumniabáris :
traditions.KJV: and thou hast greedily gained of thy neighbours by extortion ,

12.english_reference: and hast forgotten me , saith the Lord GOD

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹתִ֣ י שָׁכַ֔חַתְּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥ י יְהוִֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐμοῦ δὲ ἐπελάθου , λέγει Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: meíque oblíta es , ait Dóminus Deus .
traditions.KJV: and hast forgotten me , saith the Lord GOD .

13.english_reference: Behold , therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made

traditions.WLC: וְ הִנֵּה֙ הִכֵּ֣יתִי כַפִּ֔ י אֶל בִּצְעֵ֖ ךְ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν δ᾽ ἐπάξω χεῖρά μου ἐφ᾽ οἷς συντετέλεσαι οἷς ἐποίησας ,
traditions.VUL: Ecce complósi manus meas super avarítiam tuam , quam fecísti ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , therefore I have smitten mine hand at thy dishonest gain which thou hast made ,

13.english_reference: and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee

traditions.WLC: וְ עַ֨ל דָּמֵ֔ ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ בְּ תוֹכֵֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς αἵμασίν σου τοῖς γεγενημένοις ἐν μέσῳ σου ,
traditions.VUL: et super sánguinem , qui effúsus est in médio tui .
traditions.KJV: and at thy blood which hath been in the midst of thee .

14.english_reference: Can thine heart endure , or can thine hands be strong

traditions.WLC: הֲ יַעֲמֹ֤ד לִבֵּ ךְ֙ אִם תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יָדַ֔יִ ךְ
traditions.LXX: εἰ ὑποστήσεται ἡ καρδία σου ? εἰ κρατήσουσιν αἱ χεῖρές σου
traditions.VUL: Numquid sustinébit cor tuum , aut prævalébunt manus tuæ
traditions.KJV: Can thine heart endure , or can thine hands be strong ,

14.english_reference: in the days that I shall deal with thee ?

traditions.WLC: לַ יָּמִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ ךְ
traditions.LXX: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αἷς ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν σοί ?
traditions.VUL: in diébus , quos ego fáciam tibi ?
traditions.KJV: in the days that I shall deal with thee ?

14.english_reference: I the LORD have spoken [ it ] , and will do [ it ]

traditions.WLC: אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְ עָשִֽׂיתִי
traditions.LXX: ἐγὼ Κύριος λελάληκα καὶ ποιήσω .
traditions.VUL: ego Dóminus locútus sum , et fáciam .
traditions.KJV: I the LORD have spoken [ it ] , and will do [ it ] .

15.english_reference: And I will scatter thee among the heathen

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲפִיצוֹתִ֤י אוֹתָ ךְ֙ בַּ גּוֹיִ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ διασκορπιῶ σε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ,
traditions.VUL: Et dispérgam te in natiónes ,
traditions.KJV: And I will scatter thee among the heathen ,

15.english_reference: and disperse thee in the countries

traditions.WLC: וְ זֵרִיתִ֖י ךְ בָּ אֲרָצ֑וֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ διασπερῶ σε ἐν ταῖς χώραις ,
traditions.VUL: et ventilábo te in terras ,
traditions.KJV: and disperse thee in the countries ,

15.english_reference: and will consume thy filthiness out of thee

traditions.WLC: וַ הֲתִמֹּתִ֥י טֻמְאָתֵ֖ ךְ מִמֵּֽ ךְ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκλείψει ἡ ἀκαθαρσία σου ἐκ σοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et defícere fáciam immundítiam tuam a te .
traditions.KJV: and will consume thy filthiness out of thee .

16.english_reference: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen

traditions.WLC: וְ נִחַ֥לְתְּ בָּ֖ ךְ לְ עֵינֵ֣י גוֹיִ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατακληρονομήσω ἐν σοὶ κατ᾽ ὀφθαλμοὺς τῶν ἐθνῶν ,
traditions.VUL: Et possidébo te in conspéctu géntium :
traditions.KJV: And thou shalt take thine inheritance in thyself in the sight of the heathen ,

16.english_reference: and thou shalt know that I [ am ] the LORD

traditions.WLC: וְ יָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ γνώσεσθε διότι ἐγὼ Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: et scies quia ego Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: and thou shalt know that I [ am ] the LORD .

17.english_reference: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יְהִ֥י דְבַר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥ י לֵ אמֹֽר
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐγένετο λόγος Κυρίου πρὸς μὲ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Et factum est verbum Dómini ad me , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And the word of the LORD came unto me , saying ,

18.english_reference: Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אָדָ֕ם הָיוּ לִ֥ י בֵֽית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ל סוג
traditions.LXX: Υἱὲ ἀνθρώπου , ἰδοὺ γεγόνασί μοι ὁ οἶκος Ἰσραὴλ
traditions.VUL: Fili hóminis , versa est mihi domus Israel in scóriam :
traditions.KJV: Son of man , the house of Israel is to me become dross :

18.english_reference: all they [ are ] brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace

traditions.WLC: כֻּלָּ֡ ם נְ֠חֹשֶׁת וּ בְדִ֨יל וּ בַרְזֶ֤ל וְ עוֹפֶ֨רֶת֙ בְּ ת֣וֹךְ כּ֔וּר
traditions.LXX: ἀναμεμιγμένοι πάντες χαλκῷ καὶ σιδήρῳ καὶ κασσιτέρῳ καὶ μολίβῳ ,
traditions.VUL: omnes isti æs , et stannum , et ferrum , et plumbum in médio fornácis :
traditions.KJV: all they [ are ] brass , and tin , and iron , and lead , in the midst of the furnace ;

18.english_reference: they are [ even ] the dross of silver

traditions.WLC: סִגִ֥ים כֶּ֖סֶף הָיֽוּ
traditions.LXX: ἐν μέσῳ ἀργυρίου ἀναμεμιγμένος ἐστίν .
traditions.VUL: scória argénti facti sunt .
